normalized.result:
Implemented both additions.

- Paste a URL and Nest automatically fetches its title, description, final URL, and favicon.
- Fields remain editable when metadata is incomplete or unavailable.
- New bookmarks default to “To read.”
- Added a dedicated reading queue with live counts.
- Bookmarks can be marked read or returned to the queue in one click.
- Existing saved data migrates safely to the new format.

Verified against a real page from web.dev, plus four passing Playwright tests covering metadata autofill, saving, filtering, and marking items read.

Review it at [http://maker:4000](http://maker:4000).
